title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
model.gleam clear_demo_state: `    auth: NotAsked,` (line 752). client.gleam enter_demo: `        Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",` (lines 5799-5803) — overwrites model.auth unconditionally with the mock landlord.
detail: A logged-in landlord who opens /demo loses their SPA session state; demo exit sets auth NotAsked, forcing client-side re-auth even though the session cookie is intact. Carried from r2/r3 unfixed.
recommended_fix: Preserve the pre-demo auth on enter and restore it in clear_demo_state (or re-check session on exit).

title: still present since round 3: Declan fixture household income (EUR 6,500/mo) is 1.86x his primary income (EUR 3,500/mo) with co_applicant_count 0 and one occupant
evidence: app_declan_json contains `\"num_occupants\":1`, `\"monthly_income_cents\":350000`, and ends `\"household_monthly_income_cents\":650000,\"co_applicant_count\":0}` — household exceeds primary with no co-applicant; the guarantor's 310000 does not match the 300000 gap.
detail: The detail page shows a household income nobody in the story earns. Unchanged from the r3 finding.
recommended_fix: Set household to 350000 (single occupant) or add the second income source to the story.

title: still present since round 3: Marta's baked report carries 5-of-6 category scores (rental_history missing)
evidence: category_scores: "{\"income_affordability\":86,\"employment_stability\":82,\"reference_verification\":76,\"application_completeness\":90,\"red_flag_detection\":80}", — every other payload (lines 284, 297, 310, 356, 379, 402, 425) includes rental_history.
detail: Marta's pre-baked PDF omits one of the six standard category scores the real report always renders.
recommended_fix: Add rental_history to Marta's category_scores and re-bake report-a-marta.pdf.

title: still present since round 3: Aoife's baked PDF phone still hidden (employer email now aligned; the r3 note was again only half-folded)
evidence: base_row sets `    phone: None,` (line 68) and row_aoife's override (lines 122-150) never sets phone — while the client fixture carries `\"phone\":\"087 123 4567\"` for a-aoife (demo_fixtures.gleam).
detail: Employer email now matches the fixture (fixed), but the applicant phone is still dropped from the baked row, so the PDF hides data the demo detail page shows.
recommended_fix: Carry the fixture phone into row_aoife (phone: Some("087 123 4567")) and re-bake.

title: still present since round 3: pdf_prebake regen docs promise a positional CLI arg that main() never reads
evidence:
Header: `////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv
////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative` — main(): `  let priv_dir = case envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") {` (line 502); no argv read anywhere.
detail: The documented regen command's positional argument is silently ignored; only the env var works. Third round carrying this.
recommended_fix: Fix the header to document `RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=priv gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake`.

title: still present since round 3: demo_flow_test header claims bug-hunt E2E coverage that does not exist
evidence: //// resolves it. The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution. — `ls .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ | grep -i demo` returns nothing (rc=1); no demo scenario exists.
detail: The header points readers at E2E effect-execution coverage that was never written; the two-step dispatch tests are the only coverage.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the header to state the actual coverage (or add the bug-hunt demo scenario).

title: still present since round 3: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not baked-asset presence — a deleted or misnamed PDF 404s silently
evidence: `grep -rn "server/priv/static/demo" client/test/demo/report_download_test.gleam` returns nothing (rc=1); the file contains only analysis_id_maps_to_baked_key_test and every_baked_report_has_a_matching_analysis_test, both pure string-mapping pins.
detail: Nothing asserts the eight baked PDFs exist on disk, so removing or misnaming an asset stays green until a demo visitor 404s.
recommended_fix: Add a build-time check that every report_filenames entry has a matching asset under server/priv/static/demo/.

title: pdf_prebake payloads duplicate the client fixture stories across two packages with no mechanical consistency check — the drift channel behind the recurring baked-PDF mismatches
detail: Two hand-synced sources of truth for one synthetic story; the conformance suite guards only the client side. This channel produced the Aoife email/phone and Marta category-score mismatches flagged across rounds.
recommended_fix: Generate the prebake payloads from the shared fixture JSON (or add a cross-check test comparing key fields both sides).

title: demo_analytics FFI documents props carrying fixture vacancy/applicant ids, but the only Gleam entry point hardcodes an empty props object
detail: Every capture call sends "{}"; no caller can pass props, so the documented per-surface id props never exist. Harmless but misleading about what the analytics contain.
recommended_fix: Either correct the ffi.mjs comment (events carry no props) or expose a capture_with_props wrapper and use it.
